about_the_game:
The Home:

The Home: Recollections,

Play through five office nights and four different mini-games, to complete your trial week.

You will have to crawl through the attic, hide the truth from inspectors and face your Guilt head on.

You will relive your first week at Willow Wood Children's Care Home, complete tasks around the home. Don't forget; never go into the basement!

What do you want to remember?

The Home: Full Game,

Search through the abandoned Care Home, relive your trauma in hopes of freedom. Complete puzzles, get the power back on, find Arthur Blackwood and if you see a monster, remember it might be real or it might not be.

As you progress your childhood invades the present as you relive those traumatic memoires.

Play all three 'The Home' games free on Steam via the dlcs.

content_descriptors.notes:
The main story can be upsetting to some players. Jump scares are featured but can be toggled off, instead of a scream and face the game over will be static fading in for a few seconds silently followed by the game over voice line.
Currently no blood in game, hits of violence across the story.

short_description: The Home, a series of games inspired by real-life stories from UK children's care homes. These games have captured the true disgusting and vile horror of the care system. Dive into the, unfortunately accurate, world of THE HOME.
